```{=html}
  <p style="color: #475569; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 8px;">
    At first glance, both planets and stars are spherical celestial bodies orbiting through galaxies. But fundamentally, they occupy entirely different realms of physics and chemistry: 
    <strong>stars</strong> are colossal engines of thermonuclear fusion burning ionized plasma, while <strong>planets</strong> are cooled, non-fusing worlds composed of solid rock, liquids, and molecular gases.
  </p>
  <p style="margin: 0; font-size: 14px; color: #64748b;">
    Select any planet (from our Solar System or distant exoplanet systems) and any star to inspect their side-by-side differences in composition, scale, internal physics, and lifespan!
  </p>

function renderComparison() {

  const starKey = document.getElementById('select-star').value;

  const star = starsCatalog[starKey];

            <div style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: #64748b; text-transform: uppercase;">Radius</div>
            <div style="font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #1e293b; margin-top: 2px;">${planet.radius}</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style="margin-bottom: 10px;">
          <strong style="font-size: 13px; color: #334155;">🌡️ Temperature:</strong>
          <span style="font-size: 13.5px; color: #475569;">${planet.surfaceTemp}</span>
        </div>

        <div style="margin-bottom: 10px;">

        <div style="margin-bottom: 12px;">
          <strong style="font-size: 13px; color: #334155;">💨 Atmospheric Makeup:</strong>

        </div>

        <div style="padding: 10px 12px; background: #f0fdf4; border-radius: 8px; border-left: 3px solid #16a34a; font-size: 13px; color: #166534; line-height: 1.5;">
          💡 <strong>Key Fact:</strong> ${planet.funFact}
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Star Card -->
      <div style="padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #fed7aa; border-radius: 12px; background: #ffffff; border-top: 5px solid #ea580c; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(234, 88, 12, 0.08);">
        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; margin-bottom: 12px;">
          <div>
            <span style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; color: #ea580c; letter-spacing: 0.05em;">Stellar Engine</span>
            <h3 style="margin: 2px 0 0 0; color: #0f172a; font-size: 22px;">☀️ ${star.name}</h3>
          </div>
          <span style="padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; background: #ffedd5; color: #c2410c;">${star.category}</span>
        </div>

        <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 14px;">
          <div style="padding: 10px; background: #f8fafc; border-radius: 8px;">
            <div style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: #64748b; text-transform: uppercase;">Mass</div>
            <div style="font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #1e293b; margin-top: 2px;">${star.mass}</div>
          </div>
          <div style="padding: 10px; background: #f8fafc; border-radius: 8px;">
            <div style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: #64748b; text-transform: uppercase;">Radius</div>
            <div style="font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #1e293b; margin-top: 2px;">${star.radius}</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style="margin-bottom: 10px;">
          <strong style="font-size: 13px; color: #334155;">🔥 Effective Temp:</strong>
          <span style="font-size: 13.5px; color: #475569;">${star.surfaceTemp}</span>
        </div>

        <div style="margin-bottom: 10px;">
          <strong style="font-size: 13px; color: #334155;">⚛️ State of Matter:</strong>
          <p style="margin: 2px 0 0 0; font-size: 13px; color: #475569; line-height: 1.5;">${star.stateOfMatter}</p>
        </div>

        <div style="margin-bottom: 12px;">
          <strong style="font-size: 13px; color: #334155;">✨ Elemental Composition:</strong>
          <p style="margin: 2px 0 0 0; font-size: 13px; color: #475569; line-height: 1.5;">${star.composition}</p>
        </div>

        <div style="padding: 10px 12px; background: #fff7ed; border-radius: 8px; border-left: 3px solid #ea580c; font-size: 13px; color: #9a3412; line-height: 1.5;">
          💡 <strong>Key Fact:</strong> ${star.funFact}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Deep In-Depth Comparative Dimensions -->
    <div style="padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 12px; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px -2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05);">
      <h3 style="margin-top: 0; color: #0f172a; font-size: 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding-bottom: 12px;">
        🔬 Deep Physical Breakdown: How They Differ
      </h3>

      <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr)); gap: 18px; margin-top: 18px;">
        <!-- Dimension 1: Energy Engine -->
        <div style="padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #f1f5f9; border-radius: 10px; background: #fafafa;">
          <h4 style="margin: 0 0 6px 0; color: #0f172a; font-size: 15px;">⚡ 1. The Energy Engine</h4>
          <p style="margin: 0 0 8px 0; font-size: 13.5px; color: #475569; line-height: 1.5;">
            <strong>${planet.name}:</strong> ${planet.energySource}
          </p>
          <p style="margin: 0; font-size: 13.5px; color: #475569; line-height: 1.5;">
            <strong>${star.name}:</strong> ${star.energySource}
          </p>
        </div>

        <!-- Dimension 2: Internal Structure -->
        <div style="padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #f1f5f9; border-radius: 10px; background: #fafafa;">
          <h4 style="margin: 0 0 6px 0; color: #0f172a; font-size: 15px;">🏗️ 2. Core & Interior Architecture</h4>
          <p style="margin: 0 0 8px 0; font-size: 13.5px; color: #475569; line-height: 1.5;">
            <strong>${planet.name}:</strong> ${planet.interior}
          </p>
          <p style="margin: 0; font-size: 13.5px; color: #475569; line-height: 1.5;">
            <strong>${star.name}:</strong> ${star.interior}
          </p>
        </div>

        <!-- Dimension 3: Lifespan & Cosmic Fate -->
        <div style="padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #f1f5f9; border-radius: 10px; background: #fafafa;">
          <h4 style="margin: 0 0 6px 0; color: #0f172a; font-size: 15px;">⏳ 3. Lifespan & Cosmic Fate</h4>
          <p style="margin: 0 0 8px 0; font-size: 13.5px; color: #475569; line-height: 1.5;">
            <strong>${planet.name}:</strong> ${planet.lifespan}
          </p>
          <p style="margin: 0; font-size: 13.5px; color: #475569; line-height: 1.5;">
            <strong>${star.name}:</strong> ${star.lifespan}
          </p>
        </div>

        <!-- Dimension 4: Chemistry -->
        <div style="padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #f1f5f9; border-radius: 10px; background: #fafafa;">
          <h4 style="margin: 0 0 6px 0; color: #0f172a; font-size: 15px;">🧪 4. Chemical Complexity</h4>
          <p style="margin: 0; font-size: 13.5px; color: #475569; line-height: 1.5;">
            While <strong>${star.name}</strong> is dominated by fundamental light gases (H & He) broken down into raw subatomic plasma by millions of degrees of heat, <strong>${planet.name}</strong> operates at cooler temperatures where complex molecules, chemical polymers, geological minerals, and atmospheric chemistry can flourish.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  document.getElementById('select-planet').addEventListener('change', renderComparison);
  document.getElementById('select-star').addEventListener('change', renderComparison);
  renderComparison();
});
</script>
```
